subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Response Time
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Response Time.

hook.text: A user clicks 'search.' The spinner spins for five seconds. They leave. The search result was perfect.

buildup.text: Response time measures how long the system takes to reply after receiving a request.

discovery.text: It includes network time, server processing, and database queries—the full round trip.

twist.text: Average response time hides outliers. A 200ms average can mask 10-second spikes for some users.

climax.text: Percentiles tell the real story: P99 of 5 seconds means 1% of users wait painfully long.

punchline.text: Averages lie. Percentiles tell you how your slowest users feel.

quiz.question: Why are percentiles better than averages for response time?
options: They reveal how the slowest users are affected
